description: A supine hip extension exercise that wakes up gluteal musculature, stabilizes the pelvis, and strengthens hamstrings.
setup: Lie faceup on floor with knees bent at 90 degrees, feet flat on the ground hip-width apart, and arms resting along sides.
steps: Press heels firmly into floor and flatten lower back into mat to align pelvis.
Drive hips upward toward ceiling by squeezing glutes until thighs and torso form straight line.
Hold top contraction for a 1-second pause, then lower hips with control back to floor.
cues: Drive through heels rather than balls of feet
Squeeze glutes at top without arching lower back

mistakes.mistake: Overextending lumbar spine at top of the bridge
mistakes.fix: Stop hip lift once thighs and torso are in straight line with abs engaged

mistakes.mistake: Feeling tension primarily in hamstrings or quads
mistakes.fix: Adjust foot distance closer to glutes and consciously squeeze buttocks before pushing up

rep_standard: Hips elevate until thighs align with torso, brief pause at top before gentle ground touch
